content.user_title: Resolve Production Incidents with Smart Fixes
content.value_statement: Production incidents are hard to diagnose when logs, traces, code, and deployment history are scattered. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through root cause analysis, fixes, tests, rollout, and prevention.
actual_capabilities: Structures incident analysis across error signatures, stack traces, logs, traces, and deployment timelines.
Guides root cause investigation with code path analysis, git bisect, dependency checks, and state inspection.
Routes fixes to language, database, performance, security, and DevOps specialists.
Defines verification steps for tests, performance benchmarks, security checks, and deployment readiness.
Adds prevention work such as monitoring, lint rules, documentation, and postmortems.
limitations: Requires access to accurate logs, traces, stack traces, tests, and deployment history.
Does not replace human incident command, approval gates, or production change control.
Does not guarantee a fix when the failure is intermittent or poorly instrumented.
May need adaptation for teams without the listed observability or agent tools.

use_cases.title: Triage a Production Outage
use_cases.description: Analyze symptoms, affected users, observability data, and recent deployments before choosing a fix path.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a Multi-Service Regression
use_cases.description: Pass context between debugging, database, performance, and DevOps workstreams with clear ownership.

use_cases.title: Verify a Security Incident Fix
use_cases.description: Plan remediation, abuse tests, rollout controls, and prevention work for a high-risk defect.

prompt_templates.title: Triage an Incident
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner incident intake with limited context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to analyze this incident: [summary]. Review symptoms, affected users, logs, traces, and recent deployments. Return likely causes and next checks.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Root Cause
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate debugging after initial evidence is available.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to investigate root cause for [error]. Compare stack traces, code paths, dependencies, configuration drift, and recent commits. Recommend a minimal fix.

prompt_templates.title: Implement and Verify a Fix
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced repair planning for production-safe changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a production-safe fix for [root cause]. Include tests, monitoring, rollout, rollback, and approval criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Multi-Domain Response
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced incident coordination across several systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill for a complex incident spanning [systems]. Assign work across debugging, database, performance, security, and DevOps roles. Define handoffs and success metrics.

output_examples.input: Users see checkout timeouts after the latest deployment.
output: Incident summary with affected flow, error signature, first seen time, and deployment correlation.
Root cause hypothesis prioritizing database latency and cache misses.
Fix plan covering query optimization, regression tests, canary rollout, and alerts.

output_examples.input: A login security scan reports SQL injection risk.
output: Security impact assessment and affected endpoint summary.
Parameterized query remediation plan with validation and rate limiting.
Verification checklist covering abuse tests, dependency scan, and rollback criteria.

output_examples.input: Mobile users see a frontend exception in production.
output: Sentry trend summary and browser impact analysis.
Root cause path from API response shape to missing null handling.
Cross-browser test plan and API contract documentation updates.

best_practices: Start with observability evidence before changing code.
Prefer minimal fixes that directly address the root cause.
Verify with tests, performance checks, monitoring, and rollback planning.
anti_patterns: Skipping root cause analysis and patching only visible symptoms.
Deploying incident fixes without a rollback plan or monitoring.
Treating generated agent output as approved without human review.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance. Any command or deployment action must be explicitly approved and run in your environment.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is written for AI-assisted debugging and can guide Claude, Codex, and Claude Code sessions.

faq.question: Is this only for security incidents?
faq.answer: No. It also covers reliability, performance, data, frontend, backend, and deployment incidents.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the incident summary, error messages, time window, affected users, logs, traces, recent changes, and test results.

faq.question: Can it replace an incident commander?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure technical investigation, but people must manage communication, approvals, and production risk.

faq.question: How should I verify a proposed fix?
faq.answer: Use regression tests, performance checks, security review, monitoring, rollout criteria, and a tested rollback plan.
